title: Kimi no Sumire: Your Spring Flower
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sumire transfers to an all-boys high school in Tokyo and meets Tojo, the beautiful upperclassman everyone calls the school's 'Madonna', after stepping in to help him in a fight. As they grow close, both open up about past trauma and their friendship turns into romance (Renta! and Animate blurbs). The series is ongoing.
life_message: Being seen and accepted by one person can help heal old wounds.
